scripts._build:function: The API is consumed as TypeScript source (@tapas/api's main is src/index.ts), which suits tsx and vite and nothing else. A serverless runtime is plain Node: it resolved the bare import to a .ts file and could not load it. Bundling inlines every workspace package as JavaScript, so at runtime there is nothing left to resolve.
scripts.test:pg: docker start tapas-test-pg >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d --name tapas-test-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test -e POSTGRES_USER=test -e POSTGRES_DB=tapas_test -p 55432:5432 postgres:17-alpine >/dev/null && sleep 5; TEST_DATABASE=postgres vitest run
scripts._prepare: Installs the git hooks for a developer. A build machine has no hooks to install and no husky to install them with, so a failure here is not one — it must not take the install down with it.
